H_DUALM.definition: Original qualified Dual-M LS/final re-encode/floor/clipping/rounding unchanged

common_GDN_state_timing.prompt_prefill: same trusted HF/manual batched prefill, prompt-internal states not per-token QDQ
common_GDN_state_timing.after_prefill: immediately QDQ all24 recurrent states using own method before any subsequent decode kernel
common_GDN_state_timing.first_sample: original current prefill logits; do not recompute current logits after state QDQ
common_GDN_state_timing.decode: each token original shared native GDN forward then own method QDQ/writeback; next token consumes stored reconstructed values
common_GDN_state_timing.difference_from_historical_AIME: Historical original runner explicitly prefill_quantized=false; historical52/41/40 etc reference only, not automatically same strict protocol
common_GDN_state_timing.difference_from_historical_32K_streaming: 32K experiment QDQ after every prompt input token, so its history is not claimed identical
